notes.title: Notice of Update Data Distribution
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352562/6125df3b189bc6c80aa4b54ca4274d83031cbe28.png[/img]

We have distributed update data today. 
The details of the fixes and additions included in this update are as follows:

[Update Contents
・Added tips on how to play to the menu screen
・Revised explanations in the tutorial
・Added a pop-up tutorial when starting to play the solo mode for the first time
・Added text to the character selection screen in solo mode
・Adjusted some elements of the game screen design
・Made the revival potion's activation clearer
・Adjusted the wording in the revival potion's pop-up

Thank you for your cooperation.
